name: Ray Under
source:
He's a fashion model from the same office as [url=https://vndb.org/c89448]Raul[/url]. A naturally gifted model who can maintain his beauty without the need for skin care or dietary restrictions. He values the compatibility of his skeletal structure. His manager often gets angry with him for speaking to people in an informal tone, regardless of age or seniority, but he has no intention of fixing it (Raul doesn't mind). 

[Translated from [url=https://www.otomate.jp/cp/fd/chara/ray.php]official website[/url]]
